So the honest state of play is an unexplained tension with the cosmological principle's central prediction, and it is at minimum reasonable to say the assumption that we occupy no special place is under observational strain rather than confirmed.
ARG-E01.preemptive: Three moves a well-read defender will make. (1) “You are invoking the look-elsewhere effect to dismiss inconvenient data.” Then do not lean on it. Concede it cuts both ways and note Planck itself calls the features' existence uncontested; this argument does not need the anomaly to be a fluke. (2) “The ecliptic correlation could itself be the new physics.” Correct, and the response does not assume otherwise — no contaminant has been identified, and Schwarz et al. say so. The claim is narrower: correlation with our orbital plane, our galaxy's plane and our velocity vector is evidence about provenance, and it points local. A defender insisting the solar-system correlation is genuinely cosmological now owes a mechanism by which primordial perturbations knew the orientation of a planetary system formed nine billion years later — a far heavier debt than the one they are trying to collect. (3) “Fine, but it shows the universe has a preferred frame.” Grant it entirely and lose nothing. A frame or axis is an orientation; it fixes no origin. Ask what observation would distinguish Earth-at-the-centre from any other location in an axis-bearing universe — the answer is none, because every observer sees the same axis.
ARG-E01.name: CMB 'Axis of Evil' aligns with Earth / the ecliptic

ARG-E03.best_defense: You have spent most of that answer on the part of my argument I care least about. Concede the orbital dipole: yes, the Earth moves relative to the CMB, and Tycho's model has always granted the Earth an annual something — it is the Sun's circuit that carries the ephemeris, and a modulation with a one-year period is exactly what a geostatic system with an annually circling Sun-and-ether predicts too. Miller and De Witte found the same sidereal-plus-annual pair in the laboratory, and Sungenis says so on the page you quoted; you have found our signature, not refuted it. Now take the part that matters. The number-count dipole is twice the size your kinematic interpretation allows. That is not my arithmetic, it is Reviews of Modern Physics in 2025, over five sigma, and your own reply concedes the boosting measurement cannot exclude an intrinsic component of order a hundred kilometres per second. So on your own numbers the largest feature in the sky is part motion and part something else, and the something else is aligned with us. Add the bulk flows, which your standard model gets wrong at three sigma, and the quasar and radio anisotropies that Singal finds lying about a great circle fixed by the Earth's own rotation and revolution axes — his words, in Astronomy and Astrophysics, not mine. Your protractor calculation about the equator is a debating point; the physics point is that Singal, Kothari, Secrest and Sarkar all find cosmological-scale anisotropy tied to solar-system directions, and none of you can say why. I do not need the dipole to be non-kinematic. I need the universe to have a preferred direction that knows where we are, and your own literature keeps handing it to me.
ARG-E03.preemptive: This rates a 4 and the body must be changed rather than trusted to win on points. Three concrete additions, all now in the text above. (1) The annual modulation is stated with its predicted amplitude and phase, not merely its existence — 271 µK computed from the orbital speed alone, matching Planck's 270 µK, in the ecliptic plane and in phase with the ephemeris — because the Miller/De Witte assimilation move survives the bare fact and does not survive the number. (2) The boosting measurement is stated with its real error bars and an explicit concession that an intrinsic component of order 100 km/s is not excluded by it, so that a defender cannot win a point by supplying that caveat himself; what it does exclude is the claim on the page, that the dipole cannot be attributed to Earth's motion. (3) The number-count anomaly is given at full strength with its RMP citation and its counter-analyses (Darling 2022, Abghari 2024), and answered on direction rather than amplitude: every version of it is a dipole aligned with our motion and larger than it, where the geocentric prediction is zero. The solar-system-direction correlations Singal raises are real and are answered at ARG-E01 rather than restated here; the standing reply is that correlation with local frames is evidence about a signal's provenance and it points inward, and that a direction fixes no origin. One thing this entry must never do is claim the dipole excess has been explained. It has not.
ARG-E03.name: CMB dipole, dark flow and bulk-flow directionality

ARG-E13.best_defense: Start with what you just conceded, because it is fatal to your framing. You filed this cluster under 'no originator' and published that as a finding about how our literature grows — and then, when someone finally looked, the sources were sitting in the book you have been citing all along. Your 'untraced' category is an artefact of your own reading, not of our sloppiness. Now the substance. You concede that the supernova result does not entail dark energy, that a void reading was published in Astronomy & Astrophysics and developed for a decade, that cosmic birefringence stands at 3.6 sigma with its own authors unwilling to call it settled, that a Tully-Fisher dipole is favoured 877 to 1, and that DESI's own BAO is in tension with the CMB and prefers an evolving dark energy nobody can name. Every one of those is a place where the data underdetermine the model and the model is chosen on principle. The principle chosen is the Copernican one, and you admit it is an assumption that got promoted. So the honest reading of my six lines is not 'the Earth is proved central'; it is 'in six separate places the interpretation depends on assuming we are nowhere special, and that assumption is doing the work.' You have not refuted that. You have illustrated it, and then told me the tests that were run inside the assumption came out in its favour.
ARG-E13.preemptive: Rated 3: this must be answered in the body, not left to the reader, and one concrete change is required. ADD a short paragraph to the refutation, after section 2, headed on the distinction between an assumption and a tested hypothesis, making the point the defence turns on: the Copernican principle entered cosmology as an assumption and left it as a measurement, and the papers cited in this entry are the mechanism — Caldwell & Stebbins title theirs a modern test of the Copernican principle, Zhang & Stebbins a confirmation at gigaparsec radial scale, and the void was excluded by data that could have gone the other way and did not. A hypothesis that survives a test it could have failed is not the same object as the assumption it started as; cross-link ARG-R12, where that trade is the whole argument. Two further moves to pre-empt. (1) 'You corrected your own record, so your provenance work is unreliable.' Concede the correction loudly and publish it — that is what review/corrections.json is for — and note that the correction runs in the direction of giving the source MORE credit, not less: we found that someone had written these claims down carefully, with citations, and that the list dropped the care. (2) 'DESI's own tension shows the model is in trouble.' Grant it without hedging. Then note that a shift from a cosmological constant to an evolving equation of state is a change of one parameter inside an expanding universe measured with a 147 Mpc ruler laid down 13.8 billion years ago, and that no version of that result moves the Earth to the centre or stops it turning.
ARG-E13.name: Supernova dimming, BAO, birefringence and Lyman-alpha anisotropy

ARG-E17.best_defense: I am not claiming a miracle, I am making a point about method. Look at what is actually measured rather than what is inferred. The star fields balance around us. Light bends symmetrically about us. The planets ride a plane we sit in. The magnetic field we live inside is centred on us, the aurorae wrap our poles, the solar wind piles into a bow around us. Every one of those is an observation. To escape the plain reading of them, cosmology has to add a premise nobody has ever observed — that our vantage point is typical. That premise is doing all the work. You are preferring an unobservable homogeneity to an observed centrality because the alternative sits badly with a philosophical commitment made in the sixteenth century.
ARG-E17.preemptive: Expect the move from “the Copernican principle is only an assumption” to “therefore centrality is equally well supported.” It was an assumption; it stopped being one. The specific alternative — the Earth near the centre of a gigaparsec-scale spherically symmetric void — makes a checkable prediction: off-centre gas clouds would see a CMB dipole and scatter it into a first-order kinetic Sunyaev–Zel'dovich signal. ACT and SPT measured that spectrum and the required void overshoots the observed limit substantially. The homogeneity scale is likewise measured rather than posited. Expect also an attempt to make the magnetospheric items carry argumentative weight; they cannot, since a magnetosphere centred on its own planet is a fact about that planet's core, and Jupiter's is centred on Jupiter.
ARG-E17.name: Observed isotropy / Earth-centred fields imply we are the centre
